name: Stormshaft javelin
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 9
Statistics
Cost 35 gp Weight 3 lbs.
Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x2; Range 30 ft.; Type P; Special see text
Category Ranged; Proficiency Exotic
Weapon Groups Spears; Thrown
Description
This single-use javelin bears a thunderstone just behind the head. If you successfully strike a target with one of these javelins, the creature takes damage as normal and is the center of the thunderstone’s effect. If you miss, roll to see where the javelin lands (as if determining a miss with a splash weapon); that square becomes the center of the thunderstone’s effect.
